summary: The knowledge manifest and the law-coverage record are committed as shards under docs/knowledge and composed on read: the store composes the manifest from the shard tree at a commit, the scripts compose it through scripts/knowledge_index.py, lesson publication writes one record shard, and a commit that predates the shards is read from its aggregate file. Neither aggregate is committed, so two additions never touch the same line.
title: the knowledge manifest is composed from shards
